探究影响化学平衡移动的因素 · 3D 互动课件: Factors That Shift Chemical Equilibrium · 3D Interactive Lesson
选择性必修 1 · 第二章 实验活动 1（并 CHEM-34）: Selective Required Book 1 · Ch. 2, Lab Activity 1 (with CHEM-34)
改变一个条件，凭什么说平衡「往哪边移」？: When you change one condition, how can you tell which way the equilibrium "shifts"?
Q 与 K 比大小：Q<K 正向、Q>K 逆向: Compare Q with K: Q<K forward, Q>K reverse
加反应物使 Q 变小 → 正向；减反应物使 Q 变大 → 逆向: Adding reactant makes Q smaller → forward; removing reactant makes Q larger → reverse
温度改的是 K 本身：放热反应升温 K 变小 → 逆向: Temperature changes K itself: heating an exothermic reaction lowers K → reverse
读数要同温同体积才可比：温度没恢复就读会偏高: Readings are only comparable at the same temperature and volume: reading before the temperature recovers gives a high value
实验管加料、对照管不加；红色看 c(FeSCN²⁺): Add reagent to the test tube, not the control; the red shows c(FeSCN²⁺)
加碱变黄、加酸变橙；颜色看 c(CrO₄²⁻): Base turns it yellow, acid turns it orange; the color shows c(CrO₄²⁻)
1 号球在水浴里变温、2 号球 25 ℃ 对照: Bulb 1 changes temperature in a water bath; bulb 2 is a 25 °C control
当前体系的微粒按浓度等比放大（示意）: Particles of the current system scaled in proportion to concentration (illustrative)
颜色不变，反应就停了吗？: If the color stops changing, has the reaction stopped?
拖视角绕台面看一圈: Drag the view around the bench
四个站依次排开：红色的铁管、橙黄的铬管、红棕的两只球、示意放大的粒子框——粒子一: Four stations in a row: the red iron tube, the orange-yellow chromium tube, the two red-brown bulbs, and the magnified particle box. The particles keep converting both ways
平衡是动态的：v(正) = v(逆) ≠ 0，各组分浓度不变。「颜色不变」不等于: Equilibrium is dynamic: v(forward) = v(reverse) ≠ 0, and every concentration stays constant. "The color doesn't change" doesn't mean the reaction stopped; to tell which way it shifts, compare Q with K.
两支试管的颜色不再变化，是达到平衡，不是反应停止。: When the color in both tubes stops changing, equilibrium has been reached; the reaction hasn't stopped.
示意放大里粒子一直双向转化：v(正) = v(逆) ≠ 0。: In the magnified view the particles keep converting both ways: v(forward) = v(reverse) ≠ 0.
判断「是否平衡、往哪边移」，看浓度商 Q 与平衡常数 K 的大小。: To judge "is it at equilibrium, and which way does it shift", compare the reaction quotient Q with the equilibrium constant K.
去掉这一步：学生会把「颜色不变」当成「反应停了」。: Skip this step and students mistake "the color doesn't change" for "the reaction stopped".
常考「化学平衡状态的本质特征」——动态平衡、浓度不变、v(正) = v(逆)。: Commonly tested: "the essential features of chemical equilibrium": dynamic, constant concentrations, v(forward) = v(reverse).
再滴 5 滴 FeCl₃，红为什么更深？: Add 5 more drops of FeCl₃. Why does the red deepen?
把滴数拖到 5 滴（教材做法），看红色和读数: Drag the drop count to 5 (the textbook's amount) and watch the red and the reading
c(FeSCN²⁺) 由 0.379 升到 1.095 mmol/L，红色明显加: c(FeSCN²⁺) rises from 0.379 to 1.095 mmol/L and the red clearly deepens; Q = 26 < K = 146; the control tube is unchanged
加反应物的瞬间 Q 变小（< K），正反应速率大于逆反应，平衡正向移动；达到新平: The instant reactant is added, Q drops (< K), the forward rate exceeds the reverse, and the equilibrium shifts forward; at the new equilibrium Q returns to K.
facts A3.2、标准值表第 2 行: facts A3.2, standard values table row 2
0.05 mol/L FeCl₃ 5 滴 · 按 1:1 式读数: 0.05 mol/L FeCl₃ 5 drops · read by the 1:1 equation
加 Fe³⁺ 的瞬间，Q = 26 < K = 146。: The instant Fe³⁺ is added, Q = 26 < K = 146.
正向移动后 c(FeSCN²⁺) 从 0.379 升到 1.095 mmol/L: After shifting forward, c(FeSCN²⁺) rises from 0.379 to 1.095 mmol/L.
新平衡时 Q 又等于 K：K 只随温度变。: At the new equilibrium Q equals K again: K only changes with temperature.
去掉这一步：只看颜色加深，说不出「为什么」深。: Skip this step and students only see the red deepen without being able to say why.
常考「加 FeCl₃ 后红色加深，用 Q 与 K 解释」。: Commonly tested: "after adding FeCl₃ the red deepens; explain with Q and K".
加铁粉后红色为什么变浅？: Why does the red fade after adding iron powder?
加入少量铁粉，看红色褪去: Add a little iron powder and watch the red fade
c(FeSCN²⁺) 由 1.095 掉到 0.072 mmol/L，几乎褪色；: c(FeSCN²⁺) falls from 1.095 to 0.072 mmol/L, almost colorless; Q = 1.5×10³ > K = 146 (reverse)
铁粉把 Fe³⁺ 还原成 Fe²⁺（2Fe³⁺ + Fe = 3Fe²⁺），c(: Iron powder reduces Fe³⁺ to Fe²⁺ (2Fe³⁺ + Fe = 3Fe²⁺), so c(Fe³⁺) falls → Q rises above K → the equilibrium shifts in reverse.
facts A3.3、标准值表第 5 行: facts A3.3, standard values table row 5
少量铁粉 · c(Fe³⁺) 降到 5 %（示意）: A little iron powder · c(Fe³⁺) falls to 5 % (illustrative)
铁粉把 Fe³⁺ 还原，c(Fe³⁺) 变小。: Iron powder reduces Fe³⁺, lowering c(Fe³⁺).
Q = 1.5×10³ > K = 146，Q 变大 → 逆向。: Q = 1.5×10³ > K = 146: Q went up → reverse.
红色几乎褪掉（0.072 mmol/L），说明 FeSCN²⁺ 分解了。: The red almost disappears (0.072 mmol/L), showing FeSCN²⁺ has broken down.
去掉这一步：只讲「加料正向」，遇到「变浅」就答不出方向。: Skip this step and students only learn "adding reactant shifts forward" and can't give the direction when the color fades.
易错：以为铁粉直接把 FeSCN²⁺ 还原——真正被消耗的是 Fe³⁺。: Common mistake: thinking iron powder reduces FeSCN²⁺ directly. What's actually consumed is Fe³⁺.
滴 5 滴 NaOH，橙色为什么变黄？: Add 5 drops of NaOH. Why does the orange turn yellow?
把铬管拖到「NaOH 5 滴」，看颜色由橙转黄: Drag the chromium tube to "NaOH 5 drops" and watch it turn from orange to yellow
c(CrO₄²⁻) 由 0.152 升到 178 mmol/L，橙色转黄；Q =: c(CrO₄²⁻) rises from 0.152 to 178 mmol/L and the orange turns yellow; Q = 5.2×10⁻³⁵ < K = 2.3×10⁻¹⁵ (forward); the control tube stays orange
加碱中和了 H⁺，Q 变小（< K）→ 平衡正向移动：Cr₂O₇²⁻ + H₂O: Base neutralizes H⁺, Q falls (< K) → the equilibrium shifts forward: Cr₂O₇²⁻ + H₂O ⇌ 2CrO₄²⁻ + 2H⁺ moves toward CrO₄²⁻ (yellow).
facts A3.4、标准值表第 7 行: facts A3.4, standard values table row 7
铬管里是 Cr₂O₇²⁻，橙色。: The chromium tube holds Cr₂O₇²⁻, which is orange.
加碱中和 H⁺，Q 变小 → 正向，颜色转黄（CrO₄²⁻）。: Base neutralizes H⁺, Q falls → forward, and the color turns yellow (CrO₄²⁻).
对照管（不加碱）仍然是橙色。: The control tube (no base) stays orange.
去掉这一步：只会背「加碱变黄」，不知道是 Q 变小。: Skip this step and students only memorize "base turns it yellow" without knowing Q fell.
教材原文「减小生成物浓度，平衡正向移动」的标准例证。: The standard example of the textbook's statement "lowering product concentration shifts the equilibrium forward".
接着滴 H₂SO₄，为什么又变回橙色？: Now add H₂SO₄. Why does it turn back to orange?
从「NaOH 5 滴」往左拖到「H₂SO₄ 5 滴」，看黄色又变回橙色: Drag from "NaOH 5 drops" left to "H₂SO₄ 5 drops" and watch the yellow turn back to orange
c(CrO₄²⁻) 由 178 掉到 1.1×10⁻⁵ mmol/L，溶液回到橙: c(CrO₄²⁻) falls from 178 to 1.1×10⁻⁵ mmol/L and the solution returns to orange; Q = 4.1×10⁻⁷ > K (reverse)
加酸使 c(H⁺) 变大，Q 变大（> K）→ 平衡逆向移动，溶液回到 Cr₂O: Acid raises c(H⁺), Q rises (> K) → the equilibrium shifts in reverse and the solution returns to the orange of Cr₂O₇²⁻.
facts A3.4、标准值表第 9 行: facts A3.4, standard values table row 9
加酸使 c(H⁺) 变大，Q 变大 → 逆向，回到橙色。: Acid raises c(H⁺), Q rises → reverse, back to orange.
与上一步合起来：同一支管，加碱变黄、加酸变橙。: Together with the previous step: the same tube turns yellow with base and orange with acid.
两个方向都只是 Q 与 K 的比较，不需要另记一套规律。: Both directions are just Q compared with K; no separate rule to memorize.
去掉这一步：只有一半规律，学生会以为「加什么都正向」。: Skip this step and students learn only half the rule and think "adding anything shifts forward".
加碱、加酸两个方向都要能判断，且要能写出 Q 表达式。: You need to judge both directions, base and acid, and write the Q expression.
同一只球，热水里红棕更深、冰水里变浅，为什么？: The same bulb is darker red-brown in hot water and lighter in ice water. Why?
把水浴拖到 70 ℃（热水），再拖回 0 ℃（冰水）比较: Drag the water bath to 70 °C (hot), then back to 0 °C (ice) to compare
70 ℃：c(NO₂) 12.878 → 40.726 mmol/L，红棕加深，: 70 °C: c(NO₂) 12.878 → 40.726 mmol/L, the red-brown deepens, K = 8.2 < Q = 165.6 (reverse); 0 °C: falls to 4.824 mmol/L and lightens, K = 1.4×10³ > Q (forward); bulb 2 stays a 25 °C control throughout
2NO₂ ⇌ N₂O₄ 正反应放热（ΔH = −56.9 kJ/mol）：温度改: In 2NO₂ ⇌ N₂O₄ the forward reaction is exothermic (ΔH = −56.9 kJ/mol): temperature changes K itself. Heating lowers K → Q > K → reverse (more NO₂, darker red-brown); cooling raises K → Q < K → forward (lighter).
facts A2.3、A3.6、标准值表第 12、14 行: facts A2.3, A3.6, standard values table rows 12, 14
温度改变的是 K 本身，浓度瞬间不变，Q 仍是 165.6。: Temperature changes K itself; the concentrations don't change instantly, so Q is still 165.6.
70 ℃ 时 K = 8.2 < Q → 逆向，c(NO₂) 12.878 →: At 70 °C, K = 8.2 < Q → reverse, c(NO₂) 12.878 → 40.726 mmol/L.
0 ℃ 时 K = 1.4×10³ > Q → 正向，降到 4.824 mmol: At 0 °C, K = 1.4×10³ > Q → forward, falling to 4.824 mmol/L.
去掉这一步：学生最容易把「升温」当成「一定正向」。: Skip this step and students most easily assume "heating always shifts forward".
颜色加深 → 反推正反应放热（ΔH < 0），是必考的反推题。: Darker color → infer the forward reaction is exothermic (ΔH < 0): a must-know inference question.
颜色背后，粒子在做什么？: Behind the color, what are the particles doing?
在本步停留几秒，看示意放大里两边粒子的转化: Stay on this step for a few seconds and watch the particles convert both ways in the magnified view
当前体系的粒子一直互相转化：平衡时两边速率相等；改变条件后一边的粒子数明显变多，: The particles in the current system keep converting into each other: at equilibrium both rates are equal; after a change, one side clearly grows, in the direction Q/K predicts
平衡不是「粒子不动」，而是两边转化速率相等；条件一改，两边速率不再相等，粒子数此: Equilibrium isn't "particles standing still" but equal conversion rates both ways; change a condition and the rates are no longer equal, one side grows as the other shrinks, until Q = K again.
示意放大 · 粒子按浓度等比: Magnified view · particles in proportion to concentration
两边粒子一直在互相转化，从不停止。: Particles on both sides keep converting into each other and never stop.
平衡时两边速率相等，粒子数不再变化。: At equilibrium both rates are equal and the particle counts stop changing.
条件改变后一边明显变多，直到建立新的平衡。: After a change one side clearly grows, until a new equilibrium is set up.
去掉这一步：现象只能背，说不出「方向为什么会反过来」。: Skip this step and students can only memorize observations without saying "why the direction reverses".
常以微观图示题出现：从粒子数变化判断移动方向。: Often appears as a particle-diagram question: judge the shift direction from changes in particle counts.
为什么一定要等温度回到室温再比颜色？: Why must you wait for the temperature to return to room temperature before comparing colors?
打开「未回室温就读数」，看读数怎么偏: Turn on "Read before back to room temperature" and see how the reading goes wrong
读数从 12.878 跳到 26.978 mmol/L（偏高 2.09 倍），真: The reading jumps from 12.878 to 26.978 mmol/L (2.09 times too high) while the true value is still 12.878; going by this number you'd wrongly conclude "it shifted in reverse"
温度没恢复时，颜色里混着温度的影响，读数偏高；研究浓度的影响必须控制温度一致（教: Before the temperature recovers, the color includes the effect of temperature and the reading is too high; to study the effect of concentration you must keep temperature the same (textbook "Questions and Discussion" item 1: control variables, compare).
facts A3 问题与讨论 1、标准值表第 15 行: facts A3 Questions and Discussion 1, standard values table row 15
同一时刻、同温、同体积才可比: Comparable only at the same moment, temperature and volume
错误操作 · 按高 25 ℃ 的颜色读数: Wrong procedure · reading the color at 25 °C higher
温度没恢复，颜色里混着温度效应。: The temperature hasn't recovered, so the color includes a temperature effect.
打开后读数 26.978，比真值 12.878 偏高 2.09 倍。: Turned on, the reading is 26.978, 2.09 times the true 12.878.
教材要求：研究浓度影响时温度必须一致。: Textbook requirement: temperature must be the same when studying the effect of concentration.
去掉这一步：学生会把温度效应记成浓度效应。: Skip this step and students record a temperature effect as a concentration effect.
实验评价与误差分析题：指出操作错误并说明读数偏哪边。: Experiment evaluation and error analysis questions: identify the wrong step and say which way the reading is off.
考核：能不能把红色调到 c ≥ 1.00 mmol/L 并稳住？: Assessment: can you bring the red to c ≥ 1.00 mmol/L and hold it?
把铁管的 c(FeSCN²⁺) 调到达标线以上，保持 15 s: Raise the iron tube's c(FeSCN²⁺) above the pass line and hold for 15 s
达标横幅出现、加 15 分；换错滴瓶（KSCN）只能到 0.720，达不到: The pass banner appears, +15 points; using the wrong dropper bottle (KSCN) only reaches 0.720, not enough
选对试剂、按教材的量加（FeCl₃ 5 滴 → 1.095 mmol/L），并且: Choose the right reagent, add the textbook's amount (FeCl₃ 5 drops → 1.095 mmol/L), and judge by c rather than "how dark the color looks".
facts B3、标准值表第 2–3 行: facts B3, standard values table rows 2–3
要选对滴瓶：FeCl₃ 5 滴 → 1.095；KSCN 5 滴只有 0.720: Choose the right bottle: FeCl₃ 5 drops → 1.095; KSCN 5 drops gives only 0.720.
达标看的是 c，不是「颜色深不深」。: Passing is judged by c, not "how dark it looks".
多滴几滴也能达标（10 滴 → 1.440）。: A few more drops also pass (10 drops → 1.440).
去掉这一步：只会看现象，不会定量。: Skip this step and students can only observe, not quantify.
学生必做实验的操作 + 数据分析型题。: Required student experiment: procedure + data analysis questions.
未回室温就读数: Read before back to room temp
NO₂ 浓度—水浴温度: NO₂ concentration vs water bath temperature
向 Fe³⁺/SCN⁻ 平衡体系中加入少量铁粉，红色变浅的原因是: A little iron powder is added to the Fe³⁺/SCN⁻ equilibrium and the red fades because
铁粉把 Fe³⁺ 还原成 Fe²⁺，c(Fe³⁺) 减小，平衡逆向移动: Iron powder reduced Fe³⁺ to Fe²⁺, lowering c(Fe³⁺), so the equilibrium shifted in reverse
2Fe³⁺ + Fe = 3Fe²⁺，c(Fe³⁺) 减小 → Q 变大 > K: 2Fe³⁺ + Fe = 3Fe²⁺, so c(Fe³⁺) falls → Q rises > K → shift in reverse (facts A3.3).
向橙色的 K₂Cr₂O₇ 溶液中滴加 NaOH，颜色变黄，说明: NaOH is added to orange K₂Cr₂O₇ solution and it turns yellow. This shows
平衡逆向移动，Cr₂O₇²⁻ 增多: The equilibrium shifted in reverse and Cr₂O₇²⁻ increased
平衡正向移动，CrO₄²⁻ 增多: The equilibrium shifted forward and CrO₄²⁻ increased
加碱中和 H⁺，Q = c²(CrO₄²⁻)·c²(H⁺)/c(Cr₂O₇²⁻): Base neutralizes H⁺, so Q = c²(CrO₄²⁻)·c²(H⁺)/c(Cr₂O₇²⁻) falls < K → forward, and CrO₄²⁻ (yellow) increases (facts A3.4).
把充有 NO₂/N₂O₄ 的球放进热水，颜色加深，由此可以判定: A bulb filled with NO₂/N₂O₄ is put in hot water and the color deepens. From this we can conclude
升温颜色加深 = 平衡逆向（NO₂ 增多），升温向吸热方向移动，所以正反应放热（: Heating deepens the color = shift in reverse (more NO₂); heating shifts toward the endothermic direction, so the forward reaction is exothermic (facts A2.3, A3.6).
教材【实验 2-2】：把装有 NO₂/N₂O₄ 的注射器活塞往里推（压强大、浓度: Textbook Exp. 2-2: push in the plunger of a syringe containing NO₂/N₂O₄ (higher pressure, higher concentration). The color in the syringe will
教材原文：压强增大、浓度增大，颜色先变深又逐渐变浅，逐渐变浅是因为消耗了更多的: Textbook wording: as pressure and concentration rise, the color first darkens and then gradually lightens; it lightens because more NO₂ is consumed, as the equilibrium shifts toward fewer gas molecules (facts A5-4, textbook pp.38–39).
教材实验活动 1 里还做了 CuCl₂ 溶液的变温实验：加热后由蓝变绿，说明: Textbook Lab Activity 1 also heats CuCl₂ solution: it turns from blue to green, which shows
升温一定使平衡正向移动: Heating always shifts the equilibrium forward
教材给的平衡 [Cu(H₂O)₄]²⁺ + 4Cl⁻ ⇌ [CuCl₄]²⁻ +: The textbook's equilibrium [Cu(H₂O)₄]²⁺ + 4Cl⁻ ⇌ [CuCl₄]²⁻ + 4H₂O is endothermic (ΔH > 0), so heating shifts it forward, blue → green (facts A2.5); note that "heating always shifts forward" is wrong; it depends on whether the reaction absorbs or releases heat.
旋转、缩放；横向拖可以绕台面转一圈: Rotate and zoom; drag sideways to circle the bench
做完这门课：能用 Q 与 K 判断浓度、温度、压强怎么让平衡移动，并且说得清读数: After this lesson: use Q and K to judge how concentration, temperature and pressure shift an equilibrium, and explain why readings are only comparable at the same temperature and volume.
